symptom: `DESCRIBE` of a view entity on the **default (modelsdk)** engine omits the `as (… OQL …)` clause entirely (legacy renders it) — the describe→exec round-trip silently drops the query, leaving a queryless view. Reproduces on any Mendix **11.x** project
cause: On Mendix 11.0+ the OQL is stored **only** in the separate `DomainModels$ViewEntitySourceDocument`; the inline `OqlViewEntitySource.Oql` field was removed (see the writer's `if !pv.IsAtLeast(11,0)` gate in `serializeOqlViewEntitySource`). The modelsdk read (`entityFromGen`: `out.OqlQuery = src.Oql()`) only read the now-empty inline field and never followed the `SourceDocumentRef`. Legacy was correct — `loadViewEntityOqlQueries` in `sdk/mpr/reader_documents.go` already joins the source docs
insight: After building the domain models, list `ViewEntitySourceDocument` units (`mprread.ListUnitsWithContainer[*genDm.ViewEntitySourceDocument]`), map `moduleName.docName → Oql()`, and fill `OqlQuery` for any view entity with an empty `OqlQuery` + a `SourceDocumentRef` (mirrors the legacy join; guarded by a cheap pre-check so non-view projects pay nothing). When a view-entity read differs between engines on 11.x, suspect a field the platform moved out-of-line into a source document. Test: `TestGetDomainModel_ViewEntityOqlFromSourceDocument` (round-trips via both read paths)
